description: Simulation Parameters of the Modified WECC Real-world System for Power System Restoration is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Hongfei Yu. "This dataset serves as the supplementary material for a research paper. It contains the detailed structural information and parameter settings of a \"Modified Western Electricity Coordinating Council Real-World System,\" which incorporates both power system and transportation network data.The provided document includes: Bus Transportation Network Data: Detailed specifications regarding the travel time parameters of the bus ... Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
